steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable eRFX functionality required for event creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and avoid the publish control being greyed out.
Change the default event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Verify that an RFQ template was applied before entering line-item data.
Add the specified product and quantity through the line-item flow.
Confirm that the requested product row exists on the sheet.
Verify the requested quantity was entered for the first line item.
Verify the product's automatically filled variant matches the mapped test data.
Choose the required delivery location from the sheet dropdown.
Confirm the selected delivery location was retained.
Add one QA test vendor without inventing a company name.
Set the closest expressible equivalent of the requested two-hour bidding duration.
Verify the schedule summary reflects a two-hour duration.
Publish the configured RFQ and process its confirmation flow.
Assert that publication completed and the buyer reached a real project page.
